questions.question: Trace the 3-hop contagion chain from Intel Corporation through disclosed Tungsten smelters in China to the modeled export-control disruption scenario.
expected_answer_points: Intel discloses Tungsten smelter China Molybdenum Tungsten Co., Ltd. in China
China exposure links directly to the modeled export-licensing delay scenario
questions.why_flat_vector_misses: Intel's Form SD never mentions the modeled export-control shock; linking issuer -> smelter -> country -> disruption requires 3 graph hops across separate filings.

questions.question: Which USGS-tracked country dominates the global mineral refined by NVIDIA's disclosed Tin smelters across a 3-hop path?
expected_answer_points: NVIDIA discloses Tin smelter Global Advanced Metals Greenbushes Pty Ltd.
USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries show China dominates global Tin supply (~48% with Indonesia)
questions.why_flat_vector_misses: NVIDIA's Conflict Minerals Report lists smelter names without USGS global supply-share statistics; connecting them requires Issuer -> Smelter -> Mineral -> Country traversal.

questions.question: Trace AMD's Tantalum smelter disclosures through mineral refining to the USGS top primary-producing country.
expected_answer_points: AMD discloses Tantalum smelter AMG Brasil
USGS reports DR Congo (with Rwanda) supplies >60% of primary Tantalum with 100% US net import reliance
questions.why_flat_vector_misses: AMD's smelter table does not state USGS global production concentration; flat chunk search misses the intermediate smelter-to-mineral bridge.

questions.question: Starting from the modeled China export-control disruption event, trace upstream 3 hops to identify which public semiconductor issuers share exposure via the same Tier-2 smelter.
expected_answer_points: Shared Tier-2 smelter China Molybdenum Tungsten Co., Ltd. connects multiple issuers
Both Intel Corporation and NVIDIA Corporation inherit upstream disruption risk
questions.why_flat_vector_misses: Reverse upstream contagion from a disruption scenario to multiple issuers sharing an identical smelter requires incoming multi-hop traversal across separate Form SD filings.

questions.question: Which China-located smelters disclosed by QUALCOMM connect within 3 hops to the modeled China critical-mineral export-control disruption?
expected_answer_points: QUALCOMM discloses China facility China Molybdenum Tungsten Co., Ltd.
Facility location creates 3-hop exposure to the modeled export-control scenario
questions.why_flat_vector_misses: QUALCOMM's filing does not mention hypothetical export controls; flat vector retrieval fails to join issuer disclosures with disruption events.
